description: Manages system notifications, alerts, and messages for users, including their status and content.

endpoints.name: GetNotifications
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of notifications for the current user, with an option to filter for unread ones.

unreadOnly.description: Set to true to retrieve only unread notifications; otherwise, all notifications are returned.

example_uses: Show me only the unread messages.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this to fetch a user's notifications, either all of them or just the ones they haven't read yet.

endpoints.name: MarkAsRead
endpoints.description: Marks a specific notification as read for the current user to update notification status.

notificationId.description: The unique identifier of the notification to mark as read.

endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user opens, reads, or acknowledges a notification to update its status.

endpoints.name: UpdateNotification
endpoints.description: Updates a notification's content and status for administrative or system management purposes.

notificationId.description: The unique identifier of the notification to update.

request.description: The request body containing the new message content and/or status for the notification.

endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when administrators need to update notification content or status for system management.
